The stay lifts the preliminary injunction in place as to Sections 2 and 3 of the EO, though a preliminary injunction temporarily blocking Section 3 remains in effect in a different but related case, League of Women Voters of Massachusetts v. Trump (D. Mass.) , 1:26-cv-11549.
